english.title: Responsible person move wild / semi-wild equine out of designated area without ID
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[owner having primary day-to-day responsibility for a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), ]_
(B)_[keeper of a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), for which the owner did not have primary day-to-day responsibility,]_

moved it without an ID out of a designated area
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 18, 22 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.

Summary: A fine
